blurb: Extensively remodeled, move-in ready home on an oversized East Bakersfield lot, including new plumbing.
description: Beautifully remodeled 2-bedroom, 2-bath home on an oversized lot in East Bakersfield. This move-in ready property has been extensively updated, including new plumbing and electrical, a new kitchen with updated cabinetry, countertops and fixtures, fully renovated bathrooms, new flooring, fresh interior and exterior paint, and updated lighting. The bright, functional floor plan maximizes the living space and offers a clean, modern feel throughout. The large lot provides exceptional outdoor space with room for entertaining, future improvements or potential ADU possibilities (buyer to verify).
